questionText: Which plan contains the team training strategy?
pmaExplanation: Training and team development approaches are documented in the resource management plan.
aiExplanation: The Resource Management Plan defines how team members are acquired, developed, trained, managed, and released.
finalExplanation: Training is planned and managed through the Resource Management Plan because it is part of team development.
explanationReviewNotes: PMA and AI agree; final text combines the clearest points.
